title: Bump and go
goal: Rocks block the way to the light. The real world is noisy now: wheels slip and sensors jitter.
`bump()` is `true` right after the mouse hits something. Back up, turn, and try again.
hints: After a bump, `forward(-1)` backs up one step.
Turn away from the rock (try `turn(90)`), drive a bit, then head for the light again.
A random turn (`math.random(60, 120)`) stops the mouse from getting stuck in a loop.
name: Bump and go
